svg.title: yay-machine vs XState: all benchmarks
svg.desc: UI: sign-up form, form session (38 events): yay-machine 1.10M events/s, XState 158k events/s; 6.9× faster. Event stream: long-lived connection, replay 1,000-event trace: yay-machine 5.00M events/s, XState 349k events/s; 14× faster. Fleet: 1,000 live connections, 1 event to each of 1,000 instances: yay-machine 2.75M events/s, XState 233k events/s; 12× faster. Login request, login success + logout: yay-machine 313k requests/s, XState 19.0k requests/s; 16× faster. Login request, login rejected + retry: yay-machine 299k requests/s, XState 22.3k requests/s; 13× faster. Memory per live instance, started, idle (disconnected): yay-machine 1.23 KiB per instance, XState 2.69 KiB per instance; 2.2× less memory. Memory per live instance, connected (with heartbeat resource): yay-machine 1.33 KiB per instance, XState 3.94 KiB per instance; 3.0× less memory. Toggle, send TOGGLE: yay-machine 3.00M events/s, XState 154k events/s; 19× faster. Counter, INCREMENT + DECREMENT (guards pass): yay-machine 1.37M events/s, XState 269k events/s; 5.1× faster. Counter, INCREMENT beyond max (guard rejects): yay-machine 10.7M events/s, XState 868k events/s; 12× faster. Guards, 1st guard matches: yay-machine 2.02M events/s, XState 302k events/s; 6.7× faster. Guards, 3rd guard matches: yay-machine 1.96M events/s, XState 241k events/s; 8.1× faster. Guards, default (5th) matches: yay-machine 1.99M events/s, XState 251k events/s; 7.9× faster. Immediate transitions, routes via 1st branch: yay-machine 1.63M events/s, XState 85.4k events/s; 19× faster. Immediate transitions, routes via last branch: yay-machine 1.25M events/s, XState 89.6k events/s; 14× faster. Event resolution, handled by current state: yay-machine 2.16M events/s, XState 273k events/s; 7.9× faster. Event resolution, falls through to machine-level: yay-machine 1.76M events/s, XState 254k events/s; 6.9× faster. Event resolution, not handled (ignored): yay-machine 25.8M events/s, XState 801k events/s; 32× faster. State effects, entry + exit actions: yay-machine 2.36M events/s, XState 132k events/s; 18× faster. State effects, state-scoped resource + cleanup: yay-machine 2.06M events/s, XState 52.2k events/s; 39× faster. Lifecycle, define a 5-state machine: yay-machine 499k definitions/s, XState 32.5k definitions/s; 15× faster. Lifecycle, create + start + stop: yay-machine 968k lifecycles/s, XState 75.6k lifecycles/s; 13× faster. Lifecycle, ... with machine-scoped resource: yay-machine 1.02M lifecycles/s, XState 47.6k lifecycles/s; 22× faster. Batch of short-lived instances, batch of 10: yay-machine 894k lifecycles/s, XState 49.6k lifecycles/s; 18× faster.
